what_happened: FAILED. The Senate rejected cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 3633 by 49-50 on 2026-09-15, short of the 60 needed. Reported sticking point was ethics language on officials' crypto holdings rather than the SEC/CFTC market-structure text itself. Procedural failure, not a final vote, but it removes the 2026 enactment path that the tokenization complex was discounting. Source: cryptotimes.io 2026-09-16 reporting on the roll call; corroborated by secondary coverage. Fetched 2026-09-19.
